description: Lists curated, paste-ready Power Apps canvas control snippets (Code view / Paste code format): header bar, navigation, dialog with overlay, form with save, searchable gallery, loading overlay, empty state, language switch. Each entry shows whether it uses modern or classic controls, required variables and data sources, and the related PowerPlatformTip. Use it before writing canvas YAML from scratch, then get_yaml_snippet for the YAML.
name: list_yaml_snippets
title: List Power Apps YAML snippets
